UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated commercial user profile and workspace preferences stored under /users/{userId}.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID and request.auth.uid.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google account.

activeProjectId.description: Most recently active project identifier for cross-session resume.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update.

StudioProject.title: StudioProject
StudioProject.description: Complete multi-stage Digital Product Studio project owned by an authenticated user.

projectId.description: Project identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

revision.description: Monotonically incremented optimistic concurrency revision number.

preferences.description: Market region, language, format, and review gate preferences.

workflow.description: Stage statuses and Gate A/B/C human approval records.

marketResearch.description: Live marketplace observations and candidate topic proposals.

uvz.description: Unique Value Zone analysis and selected positioning.

transformationMap.description: Before -> Bridge -> After customer transformation map and title options.

referenceLibrary.description: Evidence-grounded reference cards and verification metadata.

outline.description: Ordered chapter outlines, drafted markdown content, and citation reviews.

productBible.description: Continuity glossary, brand voice keywords, and active reference map.

qualityReport.description: Quality assurance audit score and issues.

brand.description: Typography, colors, and e-book layout styling.

pricingReport.description: Three-tier commercial pricing ladder and rationale.

salesAssets.description: Sales page copy, FAQs, and email launch sequence.

aiSettings.description: Active Gemini model configuration, budget caps, and token usage counters (never stores secrets).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private account profile document containing verified Google account metadata and active workspace pointer.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Private subcollection of Digital Product Studio projects owned by the authenticated user.
